## Bio

**Title:** You Know Me As Dubbz

**Content:** South Florida-based DJ **You Know Me As Dubbz** has earned a reputation for delivering high-energy performances and seamless mixes across a wide range of genres. Whether spinning at local venues, exclusive parties, or on international stages, Dubbz's dynamic approach to DJing keeps the crowd moving and creates an unforgettable atmosphere.

With over **10 years of professional experience**, the journey started in the South Florida scene and expanded to corporate events, luxury weddings, premier nightclubs, and festival stages. The signature sound blends house, hip-hop, afrobeats, dancehall, top 40, and latin — curated for each unique room.

**Brands:**
- **You Know Me As Dubbz** — DJ / Entertainment brand (primary)
- **DWBEATBEAST** — Producer / Music Production identity
- **FLAVAR Co.** — Co-founder, Creative/Event affiliation

---

## Experience Highlights

- **1000+ events** performed across South Florida and beyond
- **Resident DJ** at premier venues including Avacado Cantina (Palm Beach Gardens)
- **FLAVAR Co. Call Collect** — Monthly Sunday day party series (Founder/Resident)
- **Corporate clients** — Luxury hotels, brands, conferences
- **Wedding specialist** — 50+ weddings with customized ceremony-to-reception programming

---

## Press & Recognition

- Featured in South Florida event publications
- Resident DJ for FLAVAR Presents: Call Collect (monthly, 80-220+ attendees)
- Avacado Cantina Saturday residency (2024-present)
- Camelot Yacht Club All White Party (Sep 2024)

**Standard Setup:**
- Pioneer CDJ-3000 / DJM-V10 or equivalent

- 2 x XLR outputs, 1 x booth monitor
- Power: 2 x 20A circuits

**Optional Add-ons:**
- Wireless mic for MC duties
- LED wall / visual content
- Live streaming / recording setup
- Custom lighting programming

## FAQ

**How far in advance should I book?**
- Weddings: 6-12 months recommended
- Corporate: 2-3 months
- Clubs/Private: 1-4 weeks

**Do you travel?**
Yes, throughout Florida and destination events (travel fees apply).

**What's your cancellation policy?**
Deposit is non-refundable. Full fee due 30 days prior. Force majeure clauses in contract.

**Can I provide a do-not-play list?**
Absolutely. We'll review it together during planning.

**Do you take requests?**
Yes, within the vibe/genre we agree on. Crowd-reading is part of the art.

**Do you provide equipment?**
Standard rider includes CDJs + mixer. Sound system provided by venue or rented separately. Self-contained rig available for up to 300 pax.
